use_case: Demand forecasting and reorder suggestions: sales history uploaded to a general-purpose generative AI assistant, which proposes stock levels and reorder lists that the owner places by hand in distributor portals
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI assistant (SYS-10; third-party large language model service); paid individual plan moving to a business plan with no-training terms
data_categories: Sales history (SKU, quantity, date); before 2026-08: customer names and 52 DoD order lines with asset tag ranges and building names (FCI). After 2026-09-30: SKU, quantity, and date only
human_in_the_loop: Owner reviews every suggestion, checks it against the 3-month-average baseline, and places every purchase order by hand under the POL-01 6.1 sourcing rule. No automated ordering
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(iii) external systems; DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(2) FCI only on assessed systems; FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a)) for any claims made from AI output

use_case: Drafting customer emails and quote cover notes with the same AI assistant
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI assistant (same tool as AI-001)
data_categories: Product descriptions and general wording only; no customer names, prices, or FCI
human_in_the_loop: Owner edits and sends every message; technical claims (compatibility, warranty, country of origin) checked against the OEM or distributor data sheet
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (truthful product claims); FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(iii) (no FCI)
